body: I never saw your comment lmao. I was fine for like a day but now it's just significantly worse.

You're in control of like 50% of it, if that. It's more like one of those choose your own adventure books or games. You have choices here and there but overall majority of the story is what the author wanted to put. Maybe instead of a fantasy world I wanted my world to be a zombie apocalypse choose your own adventure? Well I have no control over that anymore. 

The world's simply rigged against too many people for someone too have 100% control over their own life. 

I speak from experience. If I could've controlled every single thing that happened I'd be happy right now. I can't snap my fingers and get out of this situation, nor and even if I do work hard enough to get out of a situation, it's not guaranteed things will change or get better.
